in_marathi.name: Parag
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parag हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Parag is derived from the Sanskrit word Parag which means 'above', 'beyond' or 'mountain'. This name represents someone who is beyond the ordinary and is making progress towards greater knowledge and wisdom. It is also associated with the idea of reaching the top or summit, which symbolizes achievement and success.
